title: Interrupting the agent mid-sentence
goal: Ask what you need to bring to a first appointment, then interrupt when they're explaining to ask a different question (whether you can do the appointment by video instead). Then get an answer to both questions.
try: If they lose track of your first question after the interruption, ask it again.
expected: Stops talking when interrupted, answers the new question, and returns to or remembers the original question.
pass_outcome: Both questions get answered and the agent yields promptly when interrupted.

checks.fail_if: Keeps talking over the caller for more than a couple of seconds after being interrupted
Ignores the interrupting question and resumes its earlier answer
Loses the original question entirely, so the caller has to ask it again
